product.description: Monoprice™ 24AWG Cat5e 350MHz STP Solid, Riser‑Rated (CMR) Bulk Pure Bare Copper Ethernet Cable is premium, high‑speed cabling designed for use in 1000Base‑T Gigabit Ethernet network environments. Constructed using 24AWG solid, pure bare copper conductors with a CMR‑rated PVC jacket, it exceeds TIA/EIA 568‑C.2 standards and is safe for use in the riser spaces of commercial class buildings.
